name: bugmojo
description: Plan, generate, run and prove tests with BugMojo. Interviews you into a versioned test plan, proposes cases into a review queue with an automatable-vs-manual verdict, writes Playwright specs verified against the running app, records every run with trace/video evidence, and turns a failure into a bug with an executable repro.

mcp_url.title: BugMojo MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Full URL of the hosted BugMojo MCP endpoint, e.g. https://www.bugmojo.com/api/mcp. Append ?workspace=<slug> to pin a workspace and ?mode=qa to add the plan-review, run and evidence tools the /bugmojo:run and /bugmojo:report skills use.
